# Vendored from claudedesignskills (MIT)

These skill files are copied **unmodified** from
[freshtechbro/claudedesignskills](https://github.com/freshtechbro/claudedesignskills),
licensed **MIT** (see `LICENSE`, © 2025 Claude Skills Project).

Only the 3D / WebGL / shader-relevant skills are vendored here (the `.zip` bundles and
non-3D web-design skills from the source repo are omitted to keep this lean). Vendored:

- `threejs-webgl`
- `react-three-fiber`
- `lightweight-3d-effects`
- `web3d-integration-patterns`
- `babylonjs-engine`
- `aframe-webxr`
- `playcanvas-engine`
- `spline-interactive`
- `blender-web-pipeline`
- `substance-3d-texturing`

For the full set (animation, scroll, motion libraries, etc.), see the source repo.
